newsitem.title: USA: IMC Global elects Fowler as CEO.
newsitem.headline: IMC Global elects Fowler as CEO.

text.p: IMC Global Inc said Thursday its board elected Robert Fowler Jr to succeed Wendell Bueche as chief executive officer of the company, effective July 1, 1997.
Bueche will continue as chairman of the board.
Fowler joined the company as president and chief operating officer and a director upon completion of the merger between IMC Global and Vigoro Corp on March 1, 1996.
Prior to the merger, he was Vigoro's president and chief executive officer.
IMC Global markets crop nutrients, including nitrogen, and related products. It also sells potash and other products to industrial users and produces sulphur and oil through joint ventures.
